component.name: Karpender
component.summary: PipeWire voice privacy tool with a virtual microphone

description.p: Karpender is a desktop voice privacy tool for PipeWire-based Linux systems. It reads audio from a selected physical microphone, applies voice anonymization processing, and exposes the processed signal as a virtual microphone for calls, chats, browsers, OBS, and other recording applications.

The app is designed to keep speech understandable while making the voice harder to recognize. Controls include privacy strength, soft noise cleanup, intonation flattening, voice profiles, gain adjustment, and an optional local monitor output for testing with headphones.
Karpender creates the virtual microphone through PipeWire, so other apps can select it as a normal input source without extra plugins.

screenshot.caption: Main window with microphone selection and voice privacy controls

description.p: Initial release with PipeWire microphone capture, voice anonymization DSP, virtual microphone output, and optional monitoring.
